description: This file contains utility functions for managing native filter configurations in a dashboard, including state updates, form field management, control item extraction, dataset analysis, and validation logic.

methods.name: useForceUpdate
methods.description: Custom hook to force component re-render when active.

methods.name: setNativeFilterFieldValues
methods.description: Updates the form's filter field values for a specific filter ID.

methods.name: getControlItems
methods.description: Extracts control items from a control configuration object.

methods.name: hasTemporalColumns
methods.description: Checks if a dataset has temporal columns or if column_types is undefined/empty.

methods.name: shouldShowTimeRangePicker
methods.description: Determines whether to display the time range picker based on dataset's temporal columns.

methods.name: doesColumnMatchFilterType
methods.description: Checks if a column's type matches a specified filter type.

methods.name: isValidFilterValue
methods.description: Validates if a filter value is acceptable based on filter type and value.

methods.name: mostUsedDataset
methods.description: Identifies the most frequently used dataset from charts and datasets states.
